verdict.rationale: Chargebee is a SaaS billing platform that ships AI features (in-app AI, Chargebee AI drafting, MCP servers), so whether customer data is used to train AI models is a fair privacy question. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a data-usage policy for model training, or any related privacy control. The MCP docs' mention of 'securely access selected capabilities' concerns access scoping, not training use.
